items.text: Dallas: DNP - S Caleb Downs (concussion/ankle), S P.J. Locke (concussion), TE Jake Ferguson (ankle), WR KaVontae Turpin (ribs); limited - WR George Pickens, G Tyler Smith (ankle), LB Dee Winters (calf), TE Luke Schoonmaker. Edge Malachi Lawrence (ankle) out multiple weeks, IR considered. LB Marist Liufau, DT Jonathan Bullard, S Jalen Thompson on IR.

Indianapolis: DNP - CB Justin Walley (knee), LB Akeem Davis-Gaither (knee), TE Andrew Ogletree (knee), WR Keenan Allen and CB Charvarius Ward (rest); RB Jonathan Taylor limited (rest). Daniel Jones starts. CB Cam Taylor-Britt, WR Alec Pierce on IR.
